events.title: From the archive: Sorting what Álvaro left behind
events.summary: We care about recovering Project Spooky because an unfinished build contains work that can still find its players. Preserving that work takes more than collecting files. It also means explaining what we know about each item and where our interpretation begins.Cataloguing a document does not make it true. events.title: The House Measured Twice
events.summary: When we began organising the Project Spooky materials, we assumed that the surviving floor plan would help us understand the build. It seemed reasonable. A plan describes a space; a build executes it. If both belonged to the same project, one should help us verify the other. It did notThe drawing appears in one of the notebooks attributed to Álvaro Llorente. It is not a technical plan. events.title: The Project Spooky demo is now available
events.summary: The free Project Spooky demo is now available on Steam.This is the first publicly playable part of the unfinished project left by Álvaro Llorente and reconstructed by Team 237.Explore the house, examine what it preserves and begin to uncover the rules hidden within it. Project Spooky is a first-person psychological horror game in which observation, memory and interpretation are as important as survival.This public demo is also an essential part of our reconstruction process.
